about: The Workbench icons of the Pingus drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Pingus' own program icon (data/icons/hicolor/128x128/apps/pingus.png: art/pingus.png). Pingus-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Pingus.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Pingus.info. Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (data and everything in it, user): the Makefile copies it to each name. ReadMe.info serves ReadMe and the licence files.
